targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: V3-EXQ-591d (claim-free ARC-046 / infant_substrate:GAP-14 Phase 0->1 gate-robustness diagnostic; diversity stack armed at landed defaults; scheduler not mutated). FAIL, non_contributory, genuine non-degenerate (all 3 preconditions met, criteria_non_degenerate true). Neither candidate robust criterion discriminates: K-of-N (5/10) and EMA (alpha 0.2) both REJECT the seed-45 false-advancer (the 591c over-permissiveness leg is fixed) AND reject genuine explorers 42/43 -- because both reuse the single-episode spike threshold (0.994) as the bar for a sustained statistic, while the genuine explorers' mean level (0.32-0.84) sits below it (they spike supra-0.994 only 6-7x of 160). The discriminating signal is the mean h_pos LEVEL (the oracle's own floor ~0.20), not crossing density. Measurement / test-design gap, NOT a substrate ceiling and NOT a claim falsification (claim-free; ARC-046 NOT weakened). Pre-registered next: V3-EXQ-591e re-parameterizes the replay criterion to EMA-of-LEVEL gated at ~0.20 (supersedes 591d for the gate-criterion question).
learning_extracted: The genuine-explorer vs false-advancer discrimination is carried by the mean h_pos LEVEL (oracle floor ~0.2), not single-episode threshold-crossing density.
Robustification killed the seed-45 over-permissiveness (rejects-false-advancer leg PASSES for both K-of-N and EMA); the failure is entirely over-conservatism from the wrong threshold.
A discriminating criterion exists in the data: EMA/windowed-mean of h_pos gated at ~0.2 cleanly separates {0.32,0.56,0.84} from {0.14}. Fix is a re-parameterization, not a new mechanism.
